description: This file contains a PHP class 'TaxRate' which is part of the OpenCart admin controller for localisation tax rates. It includes methods for listing, viewing, editing, adding, and deleting tax rate records in the admin interface.

classes.name: TaxRate
classes.description: Controller class for managing localisation tax rates in the OpenCart admin backend, enabling CRUD operations and listings.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the main tax rates page, setting up breadcrumbs, URL parameters, and rendering the main view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Triggers the display of the list of tax rates by calling getList() and setting the output.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares the list of tax rates according to sorting, ordering, pagination, and filtering parameters, then renders the list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Prepares and displays the form for creating or editing a tax rate, populating current data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the saving of a new or existing tax rate record, processing form submission.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles the deletion of selected tax rate records, including permission checks and related rule deletions.
